AF.definition: "As F*." A universal intensifier used to amplify the scale of a win, a loss, or an emotional breakdown.
AF.example: I just hit a 1000x on that last spin, I’m rish AF now!

AIRDROP.definition: 1. A distribution feature via bots like C-Wallet on Telegram used to send free crypto to a group; veteran users often heighten the competition by requiring a personalized hashtag to claim the funds. 2. Free tokens sent to a wallet as a reward, often used as a marketing stunt to distract from an impending project failure.
AIRDROP.example: Go ahead and give it a try by typing /Airdrop 100 Usdt 10 -— watch how fast the degens swarm for it.

ALPHA.definition: Exclusive, high-value information or "leaks" that give a player or trader an edge over the general public.
ALPHA.example: Check the pinned message in the TG; the mod just dropped some serious alpha on the next mint.

BASED.definition: Acting with total indifference to the opinions of others; holding onto a play or a belief that everyone else calls "skem" because you know something they don't.
BASED.example: He put his last $100 on a 1.01x crash and won. Degenerate? Yes. Based? Absolutely.

BOBS.definition: A historically degenerate misspelling of "boobs." Usually requested by down-bad individuals whose bankrolls and romantic prospects are equally busted, seeking a fleeting dopamine hit to distract from their zeroed balance.
BOBS.example: I just lost my rent money on a 1.2x crash, please just send bobs so I can feel something again.

BONUS BUY.definition: A feature in slots that lets you skip the boring base-game spins and pay a massive premium (usually 100x) to jump straight into the feature round.
BONUS BUY.example: I don’t have time for 500 dead spins. Give me the $500 Bonus Buy right now.

BONUS HUNT.definition: A ritual where a player triggers multiple bonuses across different slots but doesn't open them, saving them all for a massive "reveal" at the end of the session.
BONUS HUNT.example: We’ve collected 20 bonuses. If this hunt doesn't pay, I'm going to be down bad.

BUSH.definition: The cool points are out the window, I see you Bush.
BUSH.example: Trying to act like a whale after we all watched you beg for a $1 tip? The cool points are out the window, I see you Bush.

BUST.definition: 1. The state of total liquidation; having a balance of $0.00 after a savage run of bad luck. It is the temporary death of a bankroll. 2. (Blackjack) To exceed a total of 21.
BUST.example: I’m officially bust. It’s fine though—one more quick depo and I’m running it back to get it all plus interest.

COPIUM.definition: A metaphorical, highly addictive substance inhaled to survive the physical pain of a zeroed balance; the act of convincing yourself that the next Plinko ball was "just an inch away" from the 1000x.
COPIUM.example: I just watched 100 Plinko balls hit the 0.2x in a row, but I'm still inhaling copium thinking the 'big one' is programmed to drop on the next depo.

DEGEN.definition: Short for "Degenerate." A high-risk player who prioritizes the thrill of the bet over bankroll management, logic, or basic survival.
DEGEN.example: I’m betting my gas money on a 2x coinflip. Full degen mode engaged.

DEPO.definition: Short for "Deposit." The act of transferring fresh ammunition (funds) into a casino or wallet after the previous balance has been systematically rinsed.
DEPO.example: The last run didn't go as planned. Just made a fresh depo—let's see if the luck has shifted.

DM.definition: "Direct Message." The front lines of the scamming world. In this culture, any unsolicited DM is a scam until proven otherwise.
DM.example: Ignore the DMs from anyone claiming to be 'Support'—they just want your seed phrase.

DOWN BAD.definition: 1. A state of extreme financial and emotional distress following a brutal losing streak. 2. Reaching a level of desperation where even a $1 rain in the chat feels like a life-changing event.
DOWN BAD.example: I haven't seen a green candle in weeks and my rakeback is already gone. I am officially down bad.

DUST.definition: 1. Minute, unusable fragments of cryptocurrency left in a wallet after a trade or withdrawal. 2. The digital ashes of a burnt bankroll.
DUST.example: I have about $0.05 in twenty different coins. My wallet is just a museum of dust.

DUSTING.definition: The act of scouring every corner of a casino or exchange wallet to gather microscopic remains for one final "Hail Mary" bet.
DUSTING.example: I’m dusting all my old platform wallets right now; if I can scrape together $0.50, I’m putting it on a 1000x Limbo shot.

FIAT.definition: Government-issued currency that is not backed by a physical commodity or a blockchain. Derisively referred to as "boomer money" by degens.
FIAT.example: I’m cashing out just enough fiat to pay my electric bill so I can keep the rig running.

FOMO.definition: "Fear Of Missing Out." The overwhelming psychological urge to enter a trade or place a bet simply because everyone else in the chat is posting green profit screenshots.
FOMO.example: I saw the entire chat hitting 50x multipliers on the new slot and I FOMO’d my remaining balance into it right before it went cold.

FR.definition: Short for "For real." Used to emphasize the truth of a claim, express disbelief, or lazily agree with a "based" take.
FR.example: I just ran $0.10 of dust up to $400, fr this time. No skem.

HODL.definition: "Hold On for Dear Life." The act of refusing to sell an asset regardless of how far the price crashes.
HODL.example: I don't care if the dev deleted the Telegram and moved to a private island; I'm going to HODL these bags to the moon or the grave.

HONEYDICK.definition: The act of a clout-chaser promising a massive airdrop once their "pending withdrawal" hits, only to ghost the chat. Or, when a game teases a massive result only to fail at the last second.
HONEYDICK.example: Don’t listen to him; he’s been honeydicking the chat about a $50 airdrop for two hours while waiting on a withdrawal that’s clearly never coming.

HOPIUM.definition: The irrational conviction that receiving a tiny bit of "rain" is the exact spark needed to ignite a legendary comeback and win back every cent previously lost.
HOPIUM.example: I’m sitting in the chat on pure hopium, just waiting for someone to tip me a dollar so I can run it up and fix my whole week.

JUICER.definition: A massive, high-multiplier win that provides a significant "squeeze" of profit from the house; a life-changing hit.
JUICER.example: Pop the champagne, we just landed a 2500x juicer on the very first spin of the session!

KEK.definition: The digital sound of a chat room laughing at your misfortune. A mocking "LOL" used when someone shares "Loss Porn."
KEK.example: You tried to double down on a 15 against a dealer's Ace? Kek.

KYC.definition: "Know Your Customer." The identity verification process that feels like the "final boss" of gambling. Often perceived as a tactic to delay withdrawals until the player gambles the balance to zero.
KYC.example: I finally hit a juicer, and now the site is hitting me with a surprise KYC before I can cash out. Absolute skem.

LFG.definition: "Let’s Fing Go!" The universal battle cry of the degen. Shouted in caps-lock when a multiplier lands or a pump starts.
LFG.example: The 1000x multiplier just landed on the last ball! LFG boys!

MARTINGALE.definition: A betting strategy where you double your bet after every loss. A high-speed shortcut to becoming bust.
MARTINGALE.example: He tried to Martingale his way out of a losing streak, but the wheel hit Green and now he's dusting his wallets.

MAX WIN.definition: The absolute highest payout a specific game is programmed to allow. The degen’s version of the "happily ever after."
MAX WIN.example: I finally hit the 5,000x Max Win. I’m officially retiring from the wagecuck life for at least a week.

MEEP.definition: A coded announcement used to signal that a player is completely broken and looking for a tip. Designed to bypass chat filters for "begging."
MEEP.example: I just lost my last depo on a 1.2x crash... meep.

MEFF.definition: The "dark fuel" of the gambling world, providing the chemical stamina required for multi-day sessions where sleep is considered a "loss of EV."
MEFF.example: He hasn't left the Baccarat table in three days; he’s running on pure meff and hopium.

MOON IT.definition: A supportive shout given to a fellow degen who just received a tip, expressing the hope that they will turn that dust into a massive win.
MOON IT.example: I just sent you a $1 tip—now go moon it and bring back a juicer for the boys!

NGMI.definition: "Not Gonna Make It." A diagnosis for anyone who lacks the stomach for volatility or uses "logic" to explain why they lost.
NGMI.example: If you're complaining about losing a 90% favorite coinflip, you're definitely NGMI.

NOOB.definition: A newcomer who still thinks the "Rules" button on a slot machine is helpful information.
NOOB.example: Look at this noob trying to split 10s against a dealer's 6. Pure comedy.

NOU.definition: The ultimate, unbeatable "shield" used in group chats to deflect insults, accusations of being broke, or "Loss Porn" back to the sender.
NOU.example: User A: 'You're down bad.' User B: 'Nou.'

OOF.definition: The sound air makes when leaving your body after watching a fellow degen lose a life-altering amount of money in seconds.
OOF.example: He just lost a $10k balance on a 1.01x crash? Oof, that’s a heart-stopper.

PRINT.definition: To make money so effortlessly it feels like you’ve been given the keys to the Federal Reserve. A state where every bet seems to hit.
PRINT.example: I’ve hit five bonuses in ten minutes. I am literally printing right now.

PROVABLY FAIR.definition: A cryptographic algorithm that allows a player to verify the casino didn't cheat. A sophisticated layer of copium that confirms the house took your money legally.
PROVABLY FAIR.example: I checked the seeds on my last 100 losses—it’s provably fair, so I guess the universe just hates me today.

RAIN.definition: A feature where a bot or a wealthy "whale" distributes free cryptocurrency to active users. The primary reason degens hover in chats while bust.
RAIN.example: The chat just started to rain! Quick, click the claim button before the bot times out.

RAKEBACK.definition: A small percentage of wagered funds returned as a loyalty reward. The "final meal" for a degen, often used as one last desperate depo.
RAKEBACK.example: I just claimed my weekly rakeback—it’s only $20, but it’s enough to hit a 1000x on Plinko if the seeds are right.

REKT.definition: Slang for "Wrecked." The state of having suffered a catastrophic, irreversible financial loss.
REKT.example: I put my whole portfolio into that new coin and the dev rugged it ten minutes later. I am absolutely rekt.

RIGGED.definition: The universal, immediate explanation used by every degen to describe any losing result, regardless of the actual odds.
RIGGED.example: Three '0's in a row on Roulette? This table is statistically impossible and clearly rigged.

RINSED.definition: The process of losing an entire account balance with extreme speed, as if it were simply washed away.
RINSED.example: I walked in with a $500 depo and got rinsed in four minutes flat. I didn't even see a bonus.

RIP.definition: "Rest In Peace." A standard eulogy posted in chat for a dead balance or a failed bet.
RIP.example: I just watched him lose a $5k coinflip. Rip to that man’s soul.

RISH.definition: A playful misspelling of "Rich." Used exclusively when a player hits a large multiplier and experiences a fleeting moment of financial superiority.
RISH.example: Look at that payout! We rish now, boys! Drinks are on me!

RTP.definition: "Return to Player." The theoretical percentage a game pays back over a massive sample size. A figure degens quote to justify playing despite knowing the house has the edge.
RTP.example: This slot has a 97% RTP, so technically it’s a smart investment to keep spinning.

RUG.definition: Short for "Rug Pull." A scam where developers abandon a project and run away with all the funds.
RUG.example: The website is down, the Telegram is deleted, and my tokens are worth zero. We got rugged.

RUN IT UP.definition: The legendary feat of taking a tiny amount of money and aggressively betting it until it becomes a massive withdrawal.
RUN IT UP.example: I’m going to take this $2 rakeback and run it up to $2,000. Just watch me.

SALTY.definition: A state of bitterness or agitation following a loss; usually directed at the dealer or the person in chat who just hit a jackpot.
SALTY.example: He’s being salty because he bust his depo while I’m sitting on a 50x heater.

Scatfishing.definitions: The predatory act of creating a highly convincing, usually attractive fake persona in a casino chat or Telegram group for the sole purpose of manipulating thirsty degens out of their crypto.

The weaponization of loneliness, targeting isolated and or depressed degens to extract tips, social networking, and peer tagging for drops and codes from players who think they are building a real senship.
Scatfishing.example: I was fully convinced I had a singular cosmic soul connection with CryptoSarah, but after I sent her funds to cover her year supply of tampons, she ghosted my dms and blocked me from her Telegram account. I'm pretty sure I got scatfished by a middle aged dude named Creg.

SCRIPTED.definition: The firm belief that a game’s outcome was manually manipulated by the casino in real-time specifically to target your high-stakes bet.
SCRIPTED.example: There is no way the dealer pulled a 21 against my 20. That was absolutely scripted.

SEED.definition: A string of characters used in Provably Fair algorithms to determine outcomes. The thing degens "rotate" constantly, hoping a new string will fix their luck.
SEED.example: My luck is dead. I need to change my client seed before I depo again.

SEN.definition: Short for "send." The act of tipping or transferring funds to another user in a chat.
SEN.example: Yo, can someone sen me $1? I’m dusting my wallet and I’m just short of a minimum bet.

SENDICATE.definition: A highly exclusive, tight-knit group chat of trusted degens who operate on mutual respect where every member actively contributes to communal airdrops, rains, and bailouts, ensuring that if one person hits a max win, the whole crew eats.
SENDICATE.example: I got rinsed on Roulette, but my Sendicate dropped a private rain in the group chat to get me back in the game.

SENEMY.definition: A rival whom you despise, yet you send them small tips solely to "flex" your superior wins.
SENEMY.example: I just sent my senemy a $5 tip with the note: 'Lunch is on me, hope your luck turns around.'

SENORGY.definition: A chaotic, spontaneous mass-tipping event in a casino chat rooms or Telegram groups where, multiple degens furiously send funds back and forth to each other simultaneously, usually triggered when a degen drops a massive rain or hits a life-changing max win, causing the entire community to lose their minds and throw bobs in every direction.
SENORGY.example: The chat was completely dead until someone hit a 10,000x on Plinko, and it instantly turned into a massive senorgy. I caught $50 in tips just by spamming the rocket emoji.

SENSHIP.definition: A symbiotic relationship between two degens built entirely on sending funds back and forth to keep each other in the game.
SENSHIP.example: Me and him have a true senship; he sens to me when I’m bust, and I sen to him when I hit a juicer.

SHADOW JACKING.definition: The highly classified, entirely unsolicited act of covertly masturbating while observing a group chat or listening to voice notes, secure in the knowledge that the other participants are completely oblivious. A degenerate flex of total anonymity.
SHADOW JACKING.example: The squad was deep in an emotional voice chat venting about their crippling depression,  oblivious that Kyle was on mute,  shadow jacking his man junk to the sound of their collective breakdowns.

SHADOW JERKIN.definition: The act of lurking in multiple Telegram groups without sending a single message to observe the community drama while remaining completely invisible.
SHADOW JERKIN.example: I’m not in the mood to talk to anyone today, I’m just shadow jerkin through the groups to see what’s going on.

SHEESH.definition: A high-pitched expression of shock or hype, typically used when someone posts a massive win or a reckless "all-in" bet.
SHEESH.example: He just put $2k on a single number on Roulette? Sheesh!

SKEM.definition: An ironic misspelling of "scam." Used to describe anything from a legitimate rug pull to a minor lag in the game software.
SKEM.example: The ball skipped over the 100x and landed in the 0.2x? Skem!

SMOL.definition: A playful way to describe a small win or when asking for a small tip so the degen will not owe a big tip back if a win come from it.
SMOL.example: Contrary to dis dik, she wanted my sen to be smol.

SNIPE.definition: To enter a chat and claim the last of an airdrop at the absolute perfect micro-second before the people who were too busy actually chatting realize.
SNIPE.example: I managed to snipe that airdrop with a custom hashtag while they were trying to find their sticker pack.

TILT.definition: The "death spiral" of a bankroll; a state of frustration in which a player adopts a suboptimal strategy, chasing losses with bigger, dumber bets.
TILT.example: I lost a coinflip for half my balance and went on full tilt—I ended up betting the rest on a single hand of Baccarat and lost that too.

TOUCH GRASS.definition: A derogatory suggestion aimed at someone acting overly emotional in chat; implies they have spent too much time looking at screens and need to reconnect with reality.
TOUCH GRASS.example: You’ve been arguing with a bot for three hours. Please, go touch grass.

TROLL.definition: The act of intentionally posting inflammatory, insincere, or mocking content in a chat to provoke a reaction or "saltiness" from other users.
TROLL.example: He’s not actually a millionaire, he’s just trolling the chat with fake balance screenshots.

WAGECUCK.definition: A derogatory term for someone who works a traditional 9-to-5 job rather than living off gambling volatility. Often used ironically by degens who are currently bust.
WAGECUCK.example: The depo didn’t hit. Time to go back to being a wagecuck for the next two weeks.

WAGMI.definition: "We Are All Gonna Make It." A communal chant of hope used to build morale win casinos seems to be letting people win. Often followed by immediate disaster.
WAGMI.example: Look at that graph! WAGMI, boys!

WEN LAMBO.definition: A mocking or impatient question asked when a win hasn't immediately resulted in life-changing wealth.
WEN LAMBO.example: The price went up 3%... when lambo?

WHALE.definition: A player with a bankroll so massive that their individual bets can shift the energy of an entire chat. The primary source of rain for the community.
WHALE.example: A whale just entered the lobby and started doing $1,000 Bonus Buys like they were nothing.

WHERE 2 SEN BOBS.definition: Used when a fellow degen provides game hopium inducing tip and the recipient is so thankful they feel they owe them a spectacularly inappropriate reward, like a picture of boobs,(could be male or female) as compensation.
WHERE 2 SEN BOBS.example: Bro, that $50 tip just saved me from dusting my last wallet. Where to sen bobs?

WITHDRAWAL.definition: The rare and legendary process of successfully removing funds from a platform. The only true victory in the degen world.
WITHDRAWAL.example: I hit the 500x and immediately initiated a wd. Not giving it back this time.
